budgets.note: The v1.70.0 i18n foundation added 5 658 raw / 2 462 gzip bytes to the shell (provider, locale registry, Hungarian source catalogue, language switcher) — that code has to be present before first paint, so it cannot be split out. It was paid for by finally doing what this note used to list as FUTURE work: NativeBootstrap is now lazy behind isNativeRuntime(), so the Capacitor runtime (11 604 raw / 4 934 gzip) no longer ships to browsers that can never execute it. Net effect: the shell SHRANK from 178 227/57 258 at v1.69.0 to 175 217/56 340, so the ceiling stays where v1.53.0 put it. isNativeRuntime() performs the same androidBridge / webkit.messageHandlers.bridge test @capacitor/core performs, and src/integrations/native/__tests__/ asserts the two agree against the real package — if Capacitor changes its detection, that test fails instead of the native app losing its splash screen. Prior history: re-baselined in v1.53.0 to fit the eager-NativeBootstrap baseline, and in v1.30.0 for the /klubok routes (+4 KiB raw / 1 KiB gzip).

Raw ceiling raised to 136704 in v1.51.0 (from 135168): the B2B organization surfaces added utility classes for 108 raw bytes over the old ceiling while gzip stayed at 22310, under limit. Gzip stays at 22528 and is the binding constraint — that is what crosses the network.

Raw ceiling raised to 90112 in v1.54.0: the ticketing UI (EventTickets — attendee reserve + operator management) lands in this lazy route chunk, ~2.7 KiB raw over the old 81920. Gzip is 23924, well under the 30720 ceiling and unchanged as the binding constraint.
Every admin panel is lazy-loaded per tab since v1.26.0, so this chunk is the shell only. It was 251 KB before the split, over even the old ceiling.
